newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt crude output rose, natgas fell in November.
newsitem.headline: Egypt crude output rose, natgas fell in November.

text.p: Egyptian crude oil production rose in November to an average 835,000 barrels per day (bpd) from 830,000 bpd in October, the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Tuesday.
Natural gas output fell slightly to 1.31 billion cubic feet per day from 1.32 billion cubic feet in September.
Condensate production also fell to about 35,700 bpd from 36,000 bpd, while propane and butane output slipped to 31,600 bpd from 32,000 bpd, EGPC said.
